ruling: Stdout purity for cursor-ide's response contract is guaranteed for the entire hook-processing path (post agent-resolution) and for default (CODEMIE_DEBUG unset) operation, which is stdout-clean end to end. Under CODEMIE_DEBUG=true, ~16 one-time bootstrap debug lines (provider/SSO-proxy plugin registration via cli/index.ts's unconditional `import '../providers/index.js'`, executed for every CLI subcommand before hook.ts's action ever runs) still print to stdout ahead of the response. Fixing that requires deferring cli/index.ts's eager provider-plugin imports until after argv is inspected - a cross-cutting bootstrap change outside Task 5's declared file list (hook.ts, cursor-ide.response.ts) and outside this plan's scope. Cost if wrong: a user who explicitly sets CODEMIE_DEBUG=true while running cursor-ide hooks could see Cursor mis-parse the stdout response on that one-time-per-process bootstrap window; normal (non-debug) operation is unaffected.
